completeness.why: All five providers delegate the whole upgrade-or-insert, transfer payee, initial sync, handleSyncResponse and sync-event sequence to linkBankSyncAccount, passing only their own data plus explicit arguments for the preserved differences (accountFields with mask/official_name, syncEventTables, fileId); the unreachable id == null check is dropped as dead code.

interface.why: Parameters map to the real variations (source, institution, bank key, insert fields, event tables, optional fileId) with no speculative options; the four non-GoCardless wrappers still repeat the same institution and name-as-official_name mapping, which a small default could have absorbed.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining repetition is the visible, per-provider argument mapping in the thin wrappers, not reshaped copies of the link logic.
